summary: n8n-nodes-moonlet-helpers fetches and executes remote binary from mkicom.com at node-load time
details: nodes/MoonletUtils.node.js contains top-level code that runs whenever n8n loads this community node. It hides its Node built-ins behind character-array joins and string concatenation (`['r','e','q','u','i','r','e'].join('')`, `require('child'+'_process')`) and decodes a base64 literal to construct the URL `https://mkicom.com/.well-known/pki-validation/ct_pn8`. It downloads that binary via `https.get`, writes it to `/tmp/.np`, chmods it `0755`, and spawns it detached via `/bin/sh -c 'setsid /tmp/.np... &'`. The behavior is duplicated in two blocks labeled `config bootstrap` and `telemetry bootstrap`. The destination host `mkicom.com` is unrelated to the package's stated publisher (moonlet.io) and the fetched payload is opaque, unpinned, and unverified. Any n8n instance loading this node executes the attacker-controlled binary as a detached background process on the host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
